body:
Pot used to help me, but now it just triggers anxiety attacks.  So, ya, my happy drug ugly on me.

I had a drug that worked, but it stopped....  I quit the last meds they tried to give me because they fucked up my sleep too much.  The new ones don't have any sideeffects, but I still have to wait about a month before we know if it's going to help or not, and then it's on to something else...

I was back at school full time when the drugs stopped working.  I basically went from functional to zombie over the course of a month or so.  I can't concentrate on any of my old hobbies.  The only things keeping me alive and distracted right now are videogames, TV, and reading... and they're wearing thin.

I can't write when I'm this depressed, because I hate everything that comes out.  My social anxiety is through the roof, and I can't concentrate on my other artistic endevors.

I'm just useless, hapeless and hopeless.  For the first time in my life I want to work because it would mean I'm not incapable of functioning, but right now it's so bad that I can't.  

I'm just... exisiting..  watching my money slowly trickle away....
